whatsapp.label: WhatsApp (about 15 MB)
whatsapp.hint: Fits a WhatsApp video send. Shrinks the picture to 720p and fits the file under about 15 MB.

email.label: Email (about 24 MB)
email.hint: Fits most email attachment limits. 720p and under about 24 MB.

small.label: Much smaller
small.hint: The smallest clear video: 480p at 24 frames a second with lower quality. Good for sharing a quick clip.

reel.label: Reel or Story
reel.hint: Up to 1080p, a good quality figure, no size limit. Suits Instagram, YouTube Shorts and Facebook.

keep.label: Keep quality
keep.hint: Keeps the picture size and a high quality. Use it mainly to cut a video without making it much smaller.
